name: cashflow13
description: 13-week cash flow plan with a live Excel workbook, not just an answer in chat.
long_description:
Answers the question people actually open a cash flow tool for: **which week does cash go negative, and by how much.**

Six figures in — opening cash, expected receipts, supplier payments, payroll, loan instalments, VAT and taxes due. Out comes the 13-week grid, the break-even week, the peak funding need over the period, and two or three calculated levers: what collecting 15 days earlier would buy you, what moving payroll a week would.

And a **live Excel workbook**: input cells you can edit, real formulas underneath, recalculation on open. Not a picture of a model — the model.

Running as a desktop extension, the server runs on your own machine. Your figures never leave it, and the workbook is written straight to disk.
